partners.mechanism_chain: PAX2 (HGNC:8647) —DISRUPTS→ Urogenital system development (GO:0001655); Urogenital system development (GO:0001655) —LEADS_TO→ Renal anomalies (HP:0000077); Urogenital system development (GO:0001655) —LEADS_TO→ Coloboma (HP:0000518); FOXC2 (HGNC:3767) —DISRUPTS→ Lymphatic system development (GO:0001714); Lymphatic system development (GO:0001714) —LEADS_TO→ Lymphedema (HP:0001058); Lymphatic system development (GO:0001714) —LEADS_TO→ Distichiasis (HP:0000517).
